Name: ST-01 Config files present in config/ subfolder
Objective: Verify all limits config files are deployed in the correct location.
Test Script (Step):
1. Open the config/ folder in the project root.
2. Confirm BurnInLimits.yaml exists.
3. Confirm CalLimits.yaml exists.
4. Confirm BurnInLimGroups.yaml exists.
5. Confirm CalLimGroups.yaml exists.
6. Confirm StatisticsLimitsConfig.json exists.
Test Script (Expected Result): All five files are present. No files are missing or empty.

Name: ST-02 BurnIn limits file loads without error
Objective: Verify BurnInLimits.yaml is valid YAML and loads on parse.
Test Script (Step):
1. Launch the application.
2. Open the Parse tab.
3. Set the BurnIn Limits path field to config/BurnInLimits.yaml.
4. Click Parse Data.
5. Check the log / status area for errors.
Test Script (Expected Result): No YAML parse error in the log. Application does not crash.

Name: ST-03 Cal limits file loads without error
Objective: Verify CalLimits.yaml is valid YAML and loads on parse.
Test Script (Step):
1. Launch the application.
2. Open the Parse tab.
3. Set the Cal Limits path field to config/CalLimits.yaml.
4. Click Parse Data.
5. Check the log / status area for errors.
Test Script (Expected Result): No YAML parse error in the log. Application does not crash.

Name: ST-04 BurnIn groups combobox populated after Parse Data
Objective: Verify the BurnIn group combobox is filled from BurnInLimGroups.yaml after parsing.
Precondition: ST-02 passes. At least one BurnIn _Protocol.txt file available.
Test Script (Step):
1. Launch the application.
2. Set the BurnIn Limits path to config/BurnInLimits.yaml.
3. Add at least one BurnIn _Protocol.txt file in the protocol file list.
4. Click Parse Data.
5. Switch to the Statistics tab.
6. Inspect the BurnIn Groups combobox.
Labels: Combobox contains one or more group names from BurnInLimGroups.yaml. Combobox is enabled.

Name: ST-05 Cal groups combobox populated after Parse Data
Objective: Verify the Cal group combobox is filled from CalLimGroups.yaml after parsing.
Precondition: ST-03 passes. At least one Calibration _Protocol.txt file available.
Test Script (Step):
1. Launch the application.
2. Set the Cal Limits path to config/CalLimits.yaml.
3. Add at least one Calibration _Protocol.txt file.
4. Click Parse Data.
5. Switch to the Statistics tab.
6. Inspect the Cal Groups combobox.
Labels: Combobox contains one or more group names from CalLimGroups.yaml. Combobox is enabled.

Name: ST-06 Parse Data with no protocol files – no crash
Objective: Verify the application handles an empty protocol list gracefully.
Test Script (Step):
1. Do not add any protocol files.
2. Set BurnIn / Cal limits paths or leave blank.
3. Click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Status label shows 'No protocols to be parsed.' Application does not crash.

Name: ST-07 Parse Data with no limits paths – no crash
Objective: Verify parsing proceeds without crash when limits path fields are empty.
Precondition: At least one protocol file added to the list.
Test Script (Step):
1. Leave the BurnIn Limits and Cal Limits path fields blank.
2. Add one or more protocol files.
3. Click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocols are parsed. No limits loaded (limits columns remain empty). No crash or error dialog.

Name: ST-08 Clear Data resets the parse table
Objective: Verify Clear Data removes all parsed data from the protocol table.
Precondition: At least one parse has been performed (ST-04 or ST-05).
Test Script (Step):
1. After a successful Parse Data, confirm the accepted-protocols table is populated.
2. Click Clear Data.
3. Inspect the accepted-protocols table.
4. Inspect the BurnIn and Cal groups comboboxes.
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocol table is empty. Both group comboboxes are empty / disabled.

Name: ST-09 Write Statistic populates the statistics table
Objective: Verify Write Statistic fills the stats table with limit-evaluation rows.
Precondition: ST-04 or ST-05 passed (parse completed with limits loaded).
Test Script (Step):
1. Switch to the Statistics tab.
2. Select a group from the BurnIn or Cal groups combobox.
3. Click Write Statistic.
4. Inspect the statistics table.
Test Script (Expected Result): Table is populated with rows for the selected group's limit entries (channel

Name: ST-10 Forward navigation advances active group
Objective: Verify the Next Group (?) button increments the active group.
Precondition: ST-04 passed. At least two groups exist in the BurnIn combobox.
Test Script (Step):
1. Switch to the Statistics tab.
2. Note the current group name label.
3. Click the ? (forward) navigation button.
4. Note the new group name label.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label shows the next group. Statistics table updates to reflect the new group's data.

Name: ST-11 Forward navigation wraps at the last group
Objective: Verify forward navigation wraps around to the first group.
Precondition: ST-10 passes. Navigate to the last group.
Test Script (Step):
1. Navigate forward until the last group is active (label shows the last group).
2. Click ? once more.
Test Script (Expected Result): Active group wraps back to the first group. Group name label updates accordingly.

Name: ST-12 Back navigation decrements active group
Objective: Verify the ? (back) button decrements the active group.
Precondition: ST-10 passed. Currently on the second or later group.
Test Script (Step):
1. Navigate forward to at least the second group.
2. Click ? (back).
3. Note the group name label.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label shows the previous group. Statistics table updates.

Name: ST-13 Back navigation wraps at the first group
Objective: Verify back navigation wraps around to the last group.
Test Script (Step):
1. Ensure the first group is active.
2. Click ? once.
Test Script (Expected Result): Active group wraps to the last group. Label and table update.

Name: ST-14 Clear Selected Stats Data clears the statistics view
Objective: Verify Clear Sel. Stats Data resets the statistics tab without removing parsed protocols.
Test Script (Step):
1. After a successful Write Statistic, inspect that the stats table and plot frame are populated.
2. Click Clear Sel. Stats Data.
3. Inspect the stats table, plot frame, and group name label.
Test Script (Expected Result): Plot frame is cleared. Group name label resets to default string. Parsed protocol table on the Parse tab is NOT affected.

Name: ST-15 Group name label updates when a group is set active
Objective: Verify the group name label reflects the currently active group.
Precondition: ST-04 passed. At least one group in the combobox.
Test Script (Step):
1. Switch to the Statistics tab.
2. Select a specific group from the BurnIn groups combobox.
3. Click Write Statistic (or use navigation buttons) to make that group active.
4. Read the group name label at the top of the statistics panel.
Test Script (Expected Result): Label reads 'BurnIn: <group name>' (or 'Cal: <group name>' for a Cal group)
